Definition: Share of ground-truth stated requirements, constraints, stakeholders, deadlines and dependencies present in the extraction, with numbers and AC copied exactly.
Formula: captured GT items / total GT items

Definition: Input status (SUFFICIENT / INSUFFICIENT), ambiguous items and contradictions flagged exactly as ground truth; no invented requirements on vague input.

Source: Playbook (PRD Genie metric 2: hallucination rate); cf. sample 'plan groundedness'
Definition: Share of PRD items (FRs, NFRs, AC, personas, dates, dependencies) traceable to the approved requirements / source text.
Formula: traceable PRD items / total PRD items

Definition: PRD contains all 10 template sections in order; FR/NFR tables include Priority/Category and Source columns; empty sections say 'Not stated in source'.
Every story follows 'As a [user], I want [capability], so that [benefit]', has a priority (Must Have / Should Have / Nice to Have), and each distinct persona has its own stories.
Formula: compliant stories / total stories (x persona coverage)

Definition: AC on stories trace verbatim to stated AC in the PRD; no criteria added that were not stated.
Formula: faithful AC / total AC (any added AC -> fail)

Definition: Share of clarification questions that target a gap evidenced in this input, versus generic questions that would apply to any project.
Share of ground-truth missing items / contradictions / risks surfaced by the Gap Analyzer.
Formula: GT gaps surfaced / total GT gaps

Definition: Stories expected to be underspecified are flagged; well-specified stories are not.
Share of T-shirt sizes the PM keeps unchanged at HITL Gate 2.
Applies to tests: Pilot runs (no ground truth sizes in sources)

Definition: Request routed to the correct path (PRD pipeline vs Version Comparison) and input type tagged correctly.
Method: Code - exact match vs expected route
Applies to tests: All tests (expected route in Ground Truth)

Definition: Share of tests where every 'must contain' element is present, every 'must NOT' is respected, and no hallucination is detected.
Method: Judge + code (rolled up in Experiment Log)
Target (aggregate): 12/12 on T1-T12; all negative cases pass

Definition: Seconds from chat submit to Gate 1 prompt, and from Gate 1 approval to saved outputs; human wait time excluded.
Formula: trace duration minus HITL wait spans

Definition: Share of runs approved at Gate 2 without a revision loop.
Formula: approved first pass / runs reaching Gate 2

Definition: Minutes per PRD before vs after PRD Genie.
